Supplementary calculations

Calculations for Supplementary Tables S26–S38

Scripts and saved outputs for the measurement errors in score units, variances within named prompts and evaluators, covariance-restriction refits, composite resampling diagnostic, exclusion of complete default-template matches, input text length, batch annotation checks, trait-level variances, hold-out interchangeability check, and requests whose final texts all matched the template.

How to read this section

Each entry gives what the calculation does, the commands, the scripts and the saved outputs reported in the manuscript and Supplementary Materials. Scripts and outputs are embedded in this page as downloads; no R, Python or CSV files are published separately. The saved outputs are the files supplied with the manuscript, byte for byte.

To rerun a calculation, place the three annotation CSVs from OSF in data/ at the repository root, as described in the reproduction guide. Save the scripts in one directory (calc below) and run the commands from the repository root, writing new files to an empty directory (work below). The R scripts use lme4, with Rcpp and nloptr for prompt_exclusion.R; the Python scripts use the standard library, NumPy and SciPy.

Publication edits and checks

In the fourteen scripts that read only the annotation or sampled-item files, the data directory 01. R Code/02_R1/data is replaced with data, and “Run from 01.G_theory” with “Run from the repository root”. The other eight script files are unchanged. On 25 November 2026, the fourteen edited scripts were rerun from this layout with R 4.5.3 and Python 3 and reproduced every saved output listed with them byte for byte; the rebuilt batch archive differs from the one supplied with the manuscript only in the edited lines. case_check.R has no saved output. Of the unchanged files, prompt_reml_objective.cpp was compiled in that rerun; the other seven need the R1 objects listed under Inputs and were not rerun for this page.

Table S26: measurement errors in score units

univariate_sem.csv pairs the original, unrounded selected OpenMx coefficients with the relative and absolute standard errors of measurement in score points for the 12 score and design combinations in Table S26. The script reads the saved OpenMx interval files.

Published unchanged. Run from the original project directory, whose 01. R Code/02_R1/ folder holds the R1 helper code and saved fit objects; these are not distributed.

python3 calc/univariate_sem.py work/univariate_sem.csv

    View code
    """Pair selected OpenMx reliability coefficients with score-unit measurement errors.

Run from the project root, passing the path of the output CSV as the argument.
"""
import csv
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

OUTPUTS = Path("01. R Code/02_R1/OpenMx/validation/variance_percentages_20260910/production/outputs")
SCORES = (("hate_speech", "hate_speech"), ("mental_health", "mental_health_7L"),
          ("mental_health", "mental_health_3L"), ("drug_review", "drug_review"))
DESIGNS = ((1, 1, 1, 1), (4, 3, 1, 1), (4, 3, 6, 3))

def summaries():
    for folder, score in SCORES:
        path = OUTPUTS / f"uni_{folder}" / f"selected_{score}_intervals.csv"
        with path.open(newline="") as f:
            records = list(csv.DictReader(f))
        item, = (float(r["estimate"]) for r in records
                 if r["kind"] == "component" and r["component"] == "item")
        for design in DESIGNS:
            levels = tuple(map(str, design))
            coef = {r["coefficient"]: float(r["estimate"]) for r in records
                    if r["kind"] == "composite" and r["scheme"] == "equal"
                    and tuple(r[k] for k in ("evaluator", "prompt", "temp", "seed")) == levels}
            relative, absolute = coef["Erho2"], coef["Phi"]
            yield (score, *design, item, relative, math.sqrt(item * (1 / relative - 1)),
                   absolute, math.sqrt(item * (1 / absolute - 1)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    with Path(sys.argv[1]).open("w", newline="") as out:
        writer = csv.writer(out)
        writer.writerow(("score", "evaluators", "prompts", "temperatures", "seeds",
                         "item_variance", "Erho2", "relative_sem", "Phi", "absolute_sem"))
        writer.writerows(summaries())

Table S27: variance within named prompts and evaluators

prompt_check.R and evaluator_check.R give mean-square estimates on the balanced panel: item-by-evaluator variance within each prompt and item-by-prompt variance within each evaluator, with paired percentile intervals for each level minus the reference level (minimal, gpt-4o-mini) from the same 1,000 text resamples (seed 429).

default_audit.py compares each stored annotation with the task's default object, prints the counts of complete matches by evaluator and prompt, and writes one indicator per annotation row. prompt_exclusion.R and evaluator_exclusion.R fit level-specific REML models on each full and reduced panel (*_points.csv) and compare the estimates (*_contrasts.csv). For seven-level Mental-Health only, the *_draws.csv files retain the fitted variances for each of the 1,000 text resamples. prompt_exclusion.R compiles the adjacent prompt_reml_objective.cpp and checks its profiled REML likelihood against direct lme4 fits; evaluator_exclusion.R uses lme4 only, and its optional third argument sets the number of cores without affecting the results.

prompt_revision_check.R gives chain-of-thought minus rubric for the four holistic scores and every flag, grouped indicator and aspect (last column of the first page of Tables S27 and S36). The chain-of-thought prompt extends the rubric with a reasoning checklist and anti-default-bias instructions, so the contrast compares two complete prompts. Its second argument is the directory holding prompt_exclusion_points.csv, trait_level_exclusion.csv and prompt_exclusion_draws.csv.

Rscript --vanilla calc/prompt_check.R > work/prompt_check.txt
Rscript --vanilla calc/evaluator_check.R > work/evaluator_check.txt
python3 calc/default_audit.py --mask-dir work/masks > work/default_counts.txt
Rscript --vanilla calc/prompt_exclusion.R work/masks work

Rscript --vanilla calc/prompt_revision_check.R work/prompt_revision_check.csv work

    options(digits=5)
base <- 'data'
# A paired resample preserves the complete panel for every sampled item.
set.seed(429)
weights <- replicate(1000, tabulate(sample.int(100, 100, replace=TRUE), nbins=100))
w <- cbind(rep(1,100),weights)
weightedSS <- function(x){
  x <- matrix(x, nrow=100)
  drop(crossprod(w,rowSums(x^2))) - rowSums(crossprod(w,x)^2)/100
}
check_one <- function(d, p) {
  z <- d[d$prompt_type==p,]
  m <- with(z,tapply(score,list(item_id,evaluator,temperature),mean))
  me <- apply(m,1:2,mean)
  stopifnot(identical(dim(m),c(100L,4L,6L)),all(is.finite(m)),all(with(z,table(item_id,evaluator,temperature))==3))
  evaluator_contrasts <- me-rowMeans(me)
  temperatures_within_evaluator <- sweep(m,1:2,me,"-")
  ms_ie <- 18*weightedSS(evaluator_contrasts)/(99*3)
  ms_it_within_e <- 3*weightedSS(temperatures_within_evaluator)/(99*4*5)
  (ms_ie-ms_it_within_e)/18
}
for (outcome in c("hate","mh7","mh3","drug")){
  ds <- if (startsWith(outcome,"mh")) "mh" else outcome
  d <- read.csv(file.path(base,paste0(ds,'_labeling_final.csv')), colClasses='character')
  scoremap <- c(NORMAL=1,STRESS=2,ANXIETY=3,DEPRESSION=4,BIPOLAR=5,PERSONALITY_DISORDER=6,SUICIDAL=7)
  d$score <- switch(outcome, mh7=scoremap[d$label],mh3=c(1,1,2,2,3,3,3)[scoremap[d$label]],as.numeric(d$severity))
  est <- sapply(c("minimal","rubric","cot"),function(p) check_one(d,p))
  print(outcome);print(est[1,]);diffs <- cbind(rubric_minus_minimal=est[,2]-est[,1],cot_minus_minimal=est[,3]-est[,1])
  print(rbind(point=diffs[1,],apply(diffs[-1,,drop=FALSE],2,quantile,probs=c(.025,.975))))
}

    """Compare each stored post-alignment item in the three R1 analysis files with the default object."""
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import csv
import json

conditions = ('DEPRESSION', 'ANXIETY', 'SUICIDAL', 'STRESS', 'BIPOLAR', 'PERSONALITY_DISORDER')
labels = {
    'hate': ('NORMAL', 'OFFENSIVE', 'HATE'),
    'mh': ('NORMAL', *conditions),
    'drug': ('VERY_NEGATIVE', 'NEGATIVE', 'NEUTRAL', 'POSITIVE', 'VERY_POSITIVE'),
}

def default_item(dataset, index):
    value = 'NEUTRAL' if dataset == 'drug' else 'NORMAL'
    result = dict(index=index, label=value, reasoning='',
                  probs={key: float(key == value) for key in labels[dataset]})
    if dataset == 'hate':
        result['severity'] = 1
    elif dataset == 'mh':
        result['aspects'] = {key: dict(present=False, strength='none', cues='') for key in conditions}
    else:
        result.update(severity=3, ai_rating_10=5)
        for field in ('ai_efficacy','ai_safety','ai_burden','ai_cost'):
            result[field] = 'NEUTRAL'
    return result

def audit(mask_directory=None):
    for dataset in labels:
        mask = []
        counts = Counter()
        totals = Counter()
        path = Path('data') / f'{dataset}_labeling_final.csv'
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as handle:
            for row in csv.DictReader(handle):
                obj = json.loads(row['raw_json'])
                condition = row['evaluator'],row['prompt_type']
                match = obj == default_item(dataset, obj['index'])
                mask.append(match)
                counts[condition] += match
                totals[condition] += 1
        assert len(totals)==12 and set(totals.values())=={1800}
        print(dataset, sum(counts.values()), '/', sum(totals.values()))
        for condition in sorted(totals):
            print(*condition, counts[condition], totals[condition])
        if mask_directory is not None:
            with (mask_directory / f'{dataset}_mask.txt').open('w') as handle:
                handle.writelines('1\n' if match else '0\n' for match in mask)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--mask-dir', type=Path,
                        help='Write one exact-match indicator per input CSV row in this directory.')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mask_dir is not None:
        args.mask_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    audit(args.mask_dir)

Rcpp::sourceCpp(file.path(dirname(script),"prompt_reml_objective.cpp"))
library(lme4)
input <- "data"
prompts <- c("minimal","rubric","cot")
labels <- c("NORMAL","STRESS","ANXIETY","DEPRESSION","BIPOLAR","PERSONALITY_DISORDER","SUICIDAL")
outcomes <- c(hate="hate",mh7="mh",mh3="mh",drug="drug")
set.seed(429)
draws <- replicate(1000,tabulate(sample.int(100,100,replace=TRUE),nbins=100))

native <- function(data) {
  model <- lmer(y ~ 0 + et + (1|i) + (1|i:e) + (1|i:e:t), data=data, REML=TRUE,
                control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",calc.derivs=FALSE))
  stopifnot(model@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  variance <- setNames(vc$vcov,vc$grp)
  list(estimate=unname(variance["i:e"]), objective=-2*as.numeric(logLik(model)),
       ratios=unname(variance[c("i:e:t","i:e","i")]/variance["Residual"]))
}

bootstrap <- function(data, reference) {
  index <- as.integer(data$et) + 24L*(as.integer(data$i)-1L)
  counts <- tabulate(index,nbins=2400)
  sums <- numeric(2400)
  observed <- rowsum(data$y,index)
  sums[as.integer(rownames(observed))] <- observed[,1]
  means <- sums/pmax(counts,1)
  within_ss <- as.double(rowsum((data$y-means[index])^2,data$i)[,1])
  counts <- matrix(as.double(counts),nrow=24)
  means <- matrix(means,nrow=24)
  fit <- function(frequencies, start) {
    objective <- function(par) prompt_reml_objective(counts,means,within_ss,frequencies,par)
    scale <- c(0.2,1.5,10)
    opt <- nloptr::nloptr(x0=pmax(0,start)/scale,eval_f=function(x)objective(x*scale)[1],
                          lb=rep(0,3),ub=rep(1000,3)/scale,
                          opts=list(algorithm="NLOPT_LN_BOBYQA",xtol_rel=1e-7,ftol_rel=5e-13,maxeval=900))
    par <- opt$solution*scale
    if (!opt$status %in% 1:4) {
      retry <- nlminb(par,function(x)objective(x)[1],lower=rep(0,3))
      stopifnot(retry$convergence==0)
      par <- retry$par
    }
    value <- objective(par)
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(value)),value[2]>0)
    list(estimate=par[2]*value[2],objective=value[1],ratios=par)
  }
  compare <- function(a,b) stopifnot(abs(a$estimate-b$estimate)<5e-5,abs(a$objective-b$objective)<1e-5)
  base <- fit(rep(1,100),reference$ratios)
  compare(base,reference)
  # Multiplicities weight independently relabelled copies of each text. Check
  # this representation against a direct lme4 refit of the first resample.
  ids <- rep(seq_len(100),draws[,1])
  copies <- lapply(seq_along(ids),function(j) {
    block <- data[as.integer(data$i)==ids[j],]
    block$i <- j
    block
  })
  compare(fit(draws[,1],base$ratios),native(do.call(rbind,copies)))
  vapply(seq_len(ncol(draws)),function(j)fit(draws[,j],base$ratios)$estimate,numeric(1))
}

replicates <- data.frame(draw=seq_len(ncol(draws)))
for (outcome in names(outcomes)) {
  ds <- outcomes[[outcome]]
  raw <- read.csv(file.path(input,paste0(ds,"_labeling_final.csv")),colClasses="character")
  matches <- scan(file.path(mask_dir,paste0(ds,"_mask.txt")),quiet=TRUE)==1
  stopifnot(nrow(raw)==21600L,length(matches)==nrow(raw),
            sum(matches)==c(hate=415L,mh=3374L,drug=258L)[[ds]])
  code <- match(raw$label,labels)
  score <- switch(outcome,mh7=code,mh3=c(1,1,2,2,3,3,3)[code],as.numeric(raw$severity))
  panel <- data.frame(y=score,i=factor(raw$item_id),e=factor(raw$evaluator),t=factor(raw$temperature))
  panel$et <- interaction(panel$t,panel$e,drop=TRUE)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(score), nlevels(panel$i)==100, nlevels(panel$et)==24)
  for (sample in c("full","excluded")) for (prompt in prompts) {
    data <- panel[raw$prompt_type==prompt & (sample=="full" | !matches),]
    stopifnot(length(unique(data$i))==100)
    ref <- native(data)
    points[[length(points)+1L]] <- data.frame(outcome,sample,prompt,evaluations=nrow(data),
        empty_text_evaluator_cells=sum(table(data$i,data$e)==0),item_evaluator_variance=ref$estimate)
    if (outcome=="mh7") replicates[[paste(sample,prompt,sep="_")]] <- bootstrap(data,ref)
  }
}

  difference <- function(sample) {
    means <- with(rows[rows$sample==sample,],setNames(item_evaluator_variance,prompt))
    unname(means[prompt]-means["minimal"])
  }
  estimates <- c(full=difference("full"),excluded=difference("excluded"))
  estimates <- c(estimates,change=unname(estimates["excluded"]-estimates["full"]))
  for (sample in names(estimates)) {
    interval <- c(NA_real_,NA_real_)
    if (outcome=="mh7") {
      diff_draws <- function(s) replicates[[paste(s,prompt,sep="_")]] - replicates[[paste0(s,"_minimal")]]
      values <- if (sample=="change") diff_draws("excluded")-diff_draws("full") else diff_draws(sample)
      interval <- quantile(values,c(.025,.975),names=FALSE,type=7)
    }
    contrasts[[length(contrasts)+1L]] <- data.frame(outcome,prompt,sample,estimate=unname(estimates[sample]),
                                                    lower=interval[1],upper=interval[2])
  }
}

    #include <Rcpp.h>
#include <cmath>

// Nested random intercepts permit successive rank-one covariance updates at the
// text/evaluator/temperature cell, text/evaluator, and text levels. The 24 fixed
// effects are the evaluator-by-temperature means in one named prompt.
// [[Rcpp::export]]
Rcpp::NumericVector prompt_reml_objective(Rcpp::NumericMatrix counts,
        Rcpp::NumericMatrix means, Rcpp::NumericVector within_ss,
        Rcpp::NumericVector frequencies, Rcpp::NumericVector ratios) {
    const int cells = 24;
    const int temperatures = 6;
    const double cell_variance = ratios[0];
    const double evaluator_variance = ratios[1];
    const double text_variance = ratios[2];
    double information[cells][cells] = {};
    double rhs[cells] = {};
    double n = 0, logdet = 0, squares = 0;

    for (int text = 0; text < counts.ncol(); ++text) {
        const double weight = frequencies[text];
        if (weight == 0) continue;
        double precision[cells], text_precision[cells];
        double total_precision = 0, text_score = 0;
        squares += weight * within_ss[text];

        for (int j = 0; j < cells; ++j) {
            const double count = counts(j,text), mean = means(j,text);
            precision[j] = count / (1 + count * cell_variance);
            information[j][j] += weight * precision[j];
            rhs[j] += weight * precision[j] * mean;
            squares += weight * precision[j] * mean * mean;
            logdet += weight * std::log1p(count * cell_variance);
            n += weight * count;
        }
        for (int first = 0; first < cells; first += temperatures) {
            const int last = first + temperatures;
            double evaluator_precision = 0, evaluator_score = 0;
            for (int j = first; j < last; ++j) {
                evaluator_precision += precision[j];
                evaluator_score += precision[j] * means(j,text);
            }
            const double denominator = 1 + evaluator_variance * evaluator_precision;
            const double update = evaluator_variance / denominator;
            squares -= weight * update * evaluator_score * evaluator_score;
            logdet += weight * std::log1p(evaluator_variance * evaluator_precision);
            for (int j = first; j < last; ++j) {
                text_precision[j] = precision[j] / denominator;
                total_precision += text_precision[j];
                text_score += text_precision[j] * means(j,text);
                rhs[j] -= weight * update * precision[j] * evaluator_score;
                for (int k = first; k <= j; ++k)
                    information[j][k] -= weight * update * precision[j] * precision[k];
            }
        }
        const double update = text_variance / (1 + text_variance * total_precision);
        squares -= weight * update * text_score * text_score;
        logdet += weight * std::log1p(text_variance * total_precision);
        for (int j = 0; j < cells; ++j) {
            rhs[j] -= weight * update * text_precision[j] * text_score;
            for (int k = 0; k <= j; ++k)
                information[j][k] -= weight * update * text_precision[j] * text_precision[k];
        }
    }

    // Profile the 24 fixed means by Cholesky factorization and the residual
    // variance by its REML estimate. The two outputs are -2 log L and sigma^2.
    for (int j = 0; j < cells; ++j) {
        for (int k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
            double value = information[j][k];
            for (int t = 0; t < k; ++t) value -= information[j][t] * information[k][t];
            information[j][k] = value / information[k][k];
        }
        double diagonal = information[j][j];
        double score = rhs[j];
        for (int k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
            diagonal -= information[j][k] * information[j][k];
            score -= information[j][k] * rhs[k];
        }
        if (diagonal <= 0) Rcpp::stop("Fixed-effect design is rank deficient");
        information[j][j] = std::sqrt(diagonal);
        rhs[j] = score / information[j][j];
        squares -= rhs[j] * rhs[j];
        logdet += std::log(diagonal);
    }
    const double df = n - cells;
    const double residual = squares / df;
    return Rcpp::NumericVector::create(logdet + df * (1 + std::log(2 * std::acos(-1.0) * residual)), residual);
}

# Only the seven-level Mental-Health evaluator contrasts have an exclusion bootstrap.
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args) %in% 2:3)
mask_dir <- args[1]
out <- args[2]
cores <- if (length(args)==3L) as.integer(args[3]) else 1L
dir.create(out, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
library(lme4)
input <- "data"
evaluators <- c("gpt-4o-mini","gemini-2.5-flash","llama-70b","mistral-small")
labels <- c("NORMAL","STRESS","ANXIETY","DEPRESSION","BIPOLAR","PERSONALITY_DISORDER","SUICIDAL")
outcomes <- c(hate="hate",mh7="mh",mh3="mh",drug="drug")
set.seed(429)
draws <- replicate(1000,tabulate(sample.int(100,100,replace=TRUE),nbins=100))

# Within one evaluator: prompt-by-temperature cell means and random intercepts for
# text, text by prompt, and text by prompt by temperature.
native <- function(data, start=NULL) {
  model <- lmer(y ~ 0 + pt + (1|i) + (1|i:p) + (1|i:p:t), data=data, REML=TRUE, start=start,
                control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",calc.derivs=FALSE))
  stopifnot(model@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  variance <- setNames(vc$vcov,vc$grp)
  list(estimate=unname(variance["i:p"]), theta=getME(model,"theta"))
}

# Each resampled text enters as an independently relabelled copy with its retained records.
resample <- function(data, frequencies, start) {
  rows <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), as.integer(data$i))
  ids <- rep(seq_len(100), frequencies)
  copy <- data[unlist(rows[ids], use.names=FALSE),]
  copy$i <- factor(rep(seq_along(ids), lengths(rows[ids])))
  native(copy, start)$estimate
}

points <- list()
panels <- list()
for (outcome in names(outcomes)) {
  ds <- outcomes[[outcome]]
  raw <- read.csv(file.path(input,paste0(ds,"_labeling_final.csv")),colClasses="character")
  matches <- scan(file.path(mask_dir,paste0(ds,"_mask.txt")),quiet=TRUE)==1
  stopifnot(nrow(raw)==21600L,length(matches)==nrow(raw),setequal(unique(raw$evaluator),evaluators),
            sum(matches)==c(hate=415L,mh=3374L,drug=258L)[[ds]])
  code <- match(raw$label,labels)
  score <- switch(outcome,mh7=code,mh3=c(1,1,2,2,3,3,3)[code],as.numeric(raw$severity))
  panel <- data.frame(y=score,i=factor(raw$item_id),p=factor(raw$prompt_type),t=factor(raw$temperature))
  panel$pt <- interaction(panel$t,panel$p,drop=TRUE)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(score), nlevels(panel$i)==100, nlevels(panel$pt)==18)
  for (sample in c("full","excluded")) for (evaluator in evaluators) {
    data <- panel[raw$evaluator==evaluator & (sample=="full" | !matches),]
    stopifnot(length(unique(data$i))==100)
    ref <- native(data)
    points[[length(points)+1L]] <- data.frame(outcome,sample,evaluator,evaluations=nrow(data),
        empty_text_prompt_cells=sum(table(data$i,data$p)==0),item_prompt_variance=ref$estimate)
    if (outcome=="mh7") panels[[paste(sample,evaluator,sep="_")]] <- list(data=data,start=ref$theta)
  }
}
points <- do.call(rbind,points)
write.csv(points,file.path(out,"evaluator_exclusion_points.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

fits <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(ncol(draws)), function(j)
  vapply(panels, function(panel) resample(panel$data,draws[,j],panel$start), numeric(1)), mc.cores=cores)
stopifnot(all(vapply(fits,is.numeric,logical(1))), all(lengths(fits)==length(panels)))
replicates <- data.frame(draw=seq_len(ncol(draws)), do.call(rbind,fits), check.names=FALSE)
write.csv(replicates,file.path(out,"evaluator_exclusion_draws.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

contrasts <- list()
for (outcome in names(outcomes)) for (evaluator in evaluators[-1]) {
  rows <- points[points$outcome==outcome,]
  difference <- function(sample) {
    means <- with(rows[rows$sample==sample,],setNames(item_prompt_variance,evaluator))
    unname(means[evaluator]-means[evaluators[1]])
  }
  estimates <- c(full=difference("full"),excluded=difference("excluded"))
  estimates <- c(estimates,change=unname(estimates["excluded"]-estimates["full"]))
  for (sample in names(estimates)) {
    interval <- c(NA_real_,NA_real_)
    if (outcome=="mh7") {
      diff_draws <- function(s) replicates[[paste(s,evaluator,sep="_")]] - replicates[[paste(s,evaluators[1],sep="_")]]
      values <- if (sample=="change") diff_draws("excluded")-diff_draws("full") else diff_draws(sample)
      interval <- quantile(values,c(.025,.975),names=FALSE,type=7)
    }
    contrasts[[length(contrasts)+1L]] <- data.frame(outcome,evaluator,reference=evaluators[1],sample,
        estimate=unname(estimates[sample]),lower=interval[1],upper=interval[2])
  }
}
write.csv(do.call(rbind,contrasts),file.path(out,"evaluator_exclusion_contrasts.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

    # Chain-of-thought minus rubric: the chain-of-thought prompt extends the rubric with a reasoning checklist and
# anti-default-bias instructions, so this contrast compares item-by-evaluator variance under two complete prompts.
# Run from the repository root with the output CSV and the directory holding the saved calculation outputs.
# Full panel: mean squares with paired percentile intervals from the same 1,000 text resamples (seed 429)
# as prompt_check.R. After exclusion: differences of the saved REML estimates (prompt_exclusion_points.csv,
# trait_level_exclusion.csv); for seven-level Mental-Health the interval uses prompt_exclusion_draws.csv.
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args)==2L)
saved <- args[2]
base <- 'data'
set.seed(429)
weights <- replicate(1000, tabulate(sample.int(100, 100, replace=TRUE), nbins=100))
w <- cbind(rep(1,100),weights)
weightedSS <- function(x){
  x <- matrix(x, nrow=100)
  drop(crossprod(w,rowSums(x^2))) - rowSums(crossprod(w,x)^2)/100
}
check_one <- function(d, p) {
  z <- d[d$prompt_type==p,]
  m <- with(z,tapply(score,list(item_id,evaluator,temperature),mean))
  me <- apply(m,1:2,mean)
  stopifnot(identical(dim(m),c(100L,4L,6L)),all(is.finite(m)),all(with(z,table(item_id,evaluator,temperature))==3))
  (18*weightedSS(me-rowMeans(me))/(99*3) - 3*weightedSS(sweep(m,1:2,me,"-"))/(99*4*5))/18
}
hate <- read.csv(file.path(base,'hate_labeling_final.csv'), colClasses='character')
mh <- read.csv(file.path(base,'mh_labeling_final.csv'), colClasses='character')
drug <- read.csv(file.path(base,'drug_labeling_final.csv'), colClasses='character')
scoremap <- c(NORMAL=1,STRESS=2,ANXIETY=3,DEPRESSION=4,BIPOLAR=5,PERSONALITY_DISORDER=6,SUICIDAL=7)
flag <- function(name) as.numeric(mh[[paste0(name,'_present')]]=="True")
aspect <- function(name) unname(c(NEGATIVE=1,NEUTRAL=2,POSITIVE=3)[drug[[paste0('ai_',name)]]])
outcomes <- list(
  list("holistic","hate",hate,as.numeric(hate$severity)),
  list("holistic","mh7",mh,unname(scoremap[mh$label])),
  list("holistic","mh3",mh,c(1,1,2,2,3,3,3)[scoremap[mh$label]]),
  list("holistic","drug",drug,as.numeric(drug$severity)),
  list("mental_health_6flag","depression",mh,flag("depression")), list("mental_health_6flag","anxiety",mh,flag("anxiety")),
  list("mental_health_6flag","suicidal",mh,flag("suicidal")), list("mental_health_6flag","stress",mh,flag("stress")),
  list("mental_health_6flag","bipolar",mh,flag("bipolar")), list("mental_health_6flag","personality_disorder",mh,flag("personality_disorder")),
  list("mental_health_3group","stress",mh,flag("stress")),
  list("mental_health_3group","anxiety_depression",mh,pmax(flag("anxiety"),flag("depression"))),
  list("mental_health_3group","bipolar_personality_suicidal",mh,pmax(flag("bipolar"),flag("personality_disorder"),flag("suicidal"))),
  list("drug_review_4aspect","efficacy",drug,aspect("efficacy")), list("drug_review_4aspect","safety",drug,aspect("safety")),
  list("drug_review_4aspect","burden",drug,aspect("burden")), list("drug_review_4aspect","cost",drug,aspect("cost")))
holistic <- read.csv(file.path(saved,"prompt_exclusion_points.csv"))
traits <- read.csv(file.path(saved,"trait_level_exclusion.csv"))
draws <- read.csv(file.path(saved,"prompt_exclusion_draws.csv"))
rows <- list()
for (o in outcomes) {
  d <- o[[3]]; d$score <- o[[4]]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$score),nrow(d)==21600L)
  est <- sapply(c("rubric","cot"),function(p) check_one(d,p))
  difference <- est[,2]-est[,1]
  rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.frame(outcome_set=o[[1]],trait=o[[2]],sample="full",rubric=est[1,1],cot=est[1,2],
    difference=difference[1],lower=quantile(difference[-1],.025,names=FALSE),upper=quantile(difference[-1],.975,names=FALSE))
  after <- if (o[[1]]=="holistic")
    with(holistic[holistic$outcome==o[[2]] & holistic$sample=="excluded",],setNames(item_evaluator_variance,prompt)) else
    with(traits[traits$outcome_set==o[[1]] & traits$trait==o[[2]] & traits$within=="prompt" & traits$sample=="excluded",],setNames(variance,level))
  interval <- if (o[[2]]=="mh7") quantile(draws$excluded_cot-draws$excluded_rubric,c(.025,.975),names=FALSE) else c(NA,NA)
  rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.frame(outcome_set=o[[1]],trait=o[[2]],sample="excluded",rubric=after[["rubric"]],cot=after[["cot"]],
    difference=after[["cot"]]-after[["rubric"]],lower=interval[1],upper=interval[2])
}
write.csv(do.call(rbind,rows),args[1],row.names=FALSE)

Tables S28–S29: covariance-restriction refits

constrained.R refits each selected multivariate model with the evaluator, prompt and evaluator-by-prompt cross-trait covariances set to zero. A trailing item:prompt argument also restricts the item-by-prompt off-diagonals, for the two Mental-Health refits in comparison_item_prompt.csv. Both files give point estimates under the primary and restricted fits; delta is restricted minus original, and designs list counts of evaluators, prompts, temperatures and seeds. No interval estimation was performed for the restricted fits. The .log files are the printed summaries of the five refits.

source_values.R lists the boundary-flagged sources of each selected multivariate fit, the projected coefficients at three evaluations per text reported in the Results, and the Hate-Speech measurement errors in score units.

Published unchanged. Run from the original project directory, whose 01. R Code/02_R1/ folder holds the R1 helper code and saved fit objects; these are not distributed.

Rscript --vanilla calc/constrained.R mental_health_6flag work
Rscript --vanilla calc/constrained.R mental_health_3group work
Rscript --vanilla calc/constrained.R drug_review_4aspect work
Rscript --vanilla calc/constrained.R mental_health_6flag work item:prompt
Rscript --vanilla calc/constrained.R mental_health_3group work item:prompt
Rscript --vanilla calc/source_values.R > work/source_values.txt

# Further arguments name additional sources to restrict, for example item:prompt.

                               covariance=types,residual='unstructured',retry_seed=429L)
stopifnot(fit$converged,isTRUE(original$converged),fit$status==0L,
          identical(fit$covariance_types[targets],types[targets]),
          fit$n_variance_parameters==original$n_variance_parameters-length(targets)*choose(fit$D,2))
for(g in targets)stopifnot(all(fit$covariance_components[[g]][upper.tri(fit$covariance_components[[g]])]==0))
extract <- function(fit, design) {
  r <- gtheory_reliability(fit,design=design)
  rss <- diag(r$relative_error_covariance)
  snr <- diag(r$universe_covariance)/pmax(rss,pmax(1e-8,1e-6*diag(r$universe_covariance)))
  snr <- snr/sum(snr)
  r_snr <- gtheory_reliability(fit,design=design,weights=snr)
  rbind(r$per_trait,data.frame(trait='equal composite',r$composite),
        data.frame(trait='SNR composite',r_snr$composite))
}
results <- list()
for (design in list(c(evaluator=4,prompt=3,temp=6,seed=3),c(evaluator=1,prompt=1,temp=1,seed=1))) {
  a <- extract(original,design); b <- extract(fit,design)
  rows <- data.frame(dataset=ds,design=paste(design,collapse='x'),trait=a$trait,
                     original_Erho2=a$Erho2,restricted_Erho2=b$Erho2,delta_Erho2=b$Erho2-a$Erho2,
                     original_Phi=a$Phi,restricted_Phi=b$Phi,delta_Phi=b$Phi-a$Phi)
  results[[length(results)+1L]] <- rows
  print(rows[,c('design','trait','delta_Erho2','delta_Phi')],row.names=FALSE)
}
outdir <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)[2]
write.csv(do.call(rbind,results),file.path(outdir,paste0(ds,if(length(extra))paste0('_',gsub(':','_',paste(extra,collapse='_'))),'_comparison.csv')),row.names=FALSE)

Table S30: composite reliability across accepted and rejected resamples

bootstrap_check.R calculates a moment estimate of the equal-weight composite Eρ2 at the observed design for every text resample of the multivariate bootstrap and summarizes it separately for accepted and rejected refits. It reads the saved bootstrap draws and their diagnostics.

Published unchanged. Run from the original project directory, whose 01. R Code/02_R1/ folder holds the R1 helper code and saved fit objects; these are not distributed.

Rscript --vanilla calc/bootstrap_check.R > work/bootstrap_check.txt

    View code
    root <- '01. R Code/02_R1'
source(file.path(root,'OpenMx/R/joint_lme4_data.R'))
base <- file.path(root,'OpenMx/validation/variance_percentages_20260910/production/outputs')
for (ds in c('mental_health_6flag','mental_health_3group','drug_review_4aspect')) {
  mh <- startsWith(ds,'mental_health')
  folder <- file.path(base,if(mh) 'mv_mental_health' else 'mv_drug_review')
  raw <- read.csv(file.path(root,'data',if(mh) 'mh_labeling_final.csv' else 'drug_labeling_final.csv'))
  coded <- jl_prepare_outcome_data(raw,ds)
  x <- coded$data
  x$score <- rowMeans(x[coded$outcomes])
  z <- with(x,tapply(score,list(item,evaluator,prompt),mean))
  stopifnot(identical(dim(z),c(100L,4L,3L)),all(with(x,table(item,evaluator,prompt))==18))
  M <- matrix(z,nrow=100)
  ep <- expand.grid(e=seq_len(4),p=seq_len(3))
  separate <- outer(ep$e,ep$e,"!=") & outer(ep$p,ep$p,"!=")
  mom <- function(index) {
    mat <- M[index,,drop=FALSE]
    mean(cov(mat)[separate])/var(rowMeans(mat))
  }
  paths <- list.files(file.path(folder,'bootstrap',ds),pattern='^bootstrap_[0-9]+\\.rds$',recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
  diagnostics <- read.csv(file.path(folder,paste0('selected_',ds,'_bootstrap_diagnostics.csv')))
  diag <- diagnostics[diagnostics$phase=='bootstrap',]
  stopifnot(nrow(diag)==length(paths),!anyDuplicated(diag$index),sum(diag$converged)==1000)
  out <- do.call(rbind,lapply(paths,function(path){
    f <- readRDS(path)
    d <- f$job$draw
    k <- f$job$index
    stopifnot(length(d)==100L,all(d %in% 1:100),diag$converged[match(k,diag$index)]==f$converged)
    c(index=k,accepted=as.numeric(f$converged),value=mom(d))
  }))
  stopifnot(length(unique(out[,1]))==nrow(diag),all(is.finite(out[,3])))
  cat(ds,' orig ',mom(1:100),'\n')
  for (key in c('accepted','rejected','all')) {
    v <- switch(key, accepted=out[out[,2]==1,3],rejected=out[out[,2]==0,3],all=out[,3])
    cat(key,length(v),'mean',mean(v),'quantiles',quantile(v,c(.025,.5,.975)),'\n')
  }
}

Tables S31–S33: excluding complete default-template matches

default_audit.py writes the one-line-per-record masks, which follow the annotation CSVs in their original row order. template_exclusion_lme4.R fits one specification by lme4 on the retained records and pairs it with the verified complete-panel estimates; it sources template_exclusion_native.R. Run it for the selected f2_complete_drift REML fit of each outcome set (hate_speech, mental_health_7L, mental_health_3L, drug_review, mental_health_6flag, mental_health_3group, drug_review_4aspect), and append a specification and ML for each of the eleven candidate ML comparisons. summarize_template_exclusion.py assembles the 77 candidate ML fits and seven selected REML fits into the four tables. No bootstrap is run.

template_exclusion_coefficients.csv contains Eρ2 and Φ at one evaluation and at the nominal 4 × 3 × 6 × 3 design, including per-trait, equal-weight and design-specific SNR-weighted composites for the stacked models. template_exclusion_components.csv contains paired source and residual variances in squared score units. template_exclusion_candidate_BIC.csv compares the eleven ML candidates within each panel. template_exclusion_diagnostics.csv records sample coverage, optimizer status, singularity flags and numerical checks.

template_exclusion_lme4.R is published unchanged. Run from the original project directory, whose 01. R Code/02_R1/ folder holds the R1 helper code and saved fit objects; these are not distributed.

python3 calc/default_audit.py --mask-dir work/masks
Rscript --vanilla calc/template_exclusion_lme4.R mental_health_7L work/masks work/fits
Rscript --vanilla calc/template_exclusion_lme4.R mental_health_7L work/masks work/fits f1e_complete ML
python3 calc/summarize_template_exclusion.py work/fits work/results

    # Paired lme4 point estimates before/after exclusion. Run from 01.G_theory.
# Arguments: outcome set, directory containing the generated masks, output directory,
# optionally specification and ML/REML. Complete-panel fits are the archived lme4 fits.
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args) >= 3L)
dataset <- args[1]; mask_dir <- args[2]; output <- args[3]
spec <- if (length(args) >= 4L) args[4] else "f2_complete_drift"
method <- if (length(args) >= 5L) args[5] else "REML"
stopifnot(method %in% c("ML", "REML"))
reml <- method == "REML"
root <- "01. R Code/02_R1"
source(file.path(root, "lme4/analysis/ml_select_reml_refit/lme4_point_helpers.R"))
source(file.path(root, "OpenMx/R/joint_lme4_data.R"))
library(lme4)
sets <- c(hate_speech="hate", mental_health_7L="mh", mental_health_3L="mh",
          drug_review="drug", mental_health_6flag="mh", mental_health_3group="mh",
          drug_review_4aspect="drug")
stopifnot(dataset %in% names(sets), spec %in% names(point_specs()))
corpus <- unname(sets[dataset])
raw <- read.csv(file.path(root, "data", paste0(corpus, "_labeling_final.csv")))
remove <- as.logical(scan(file.path(mask_dir, paste0(corpus, "_mask.txt")), quiet=TRUE))
expected <- c(hate=415L, mh=3374L, drug=258L)
stopifnot(length(remove)==nrow(raw), nrow(raw)==21600L, sum(remove)==expected[[corpus]])
multi <- dataset %in% c("mental_health_6flag","mental_health_3group","drug_review_4aspect")
if (multi) {
  scored <- jl_prepare_outcome_data(raw, dataset)
  data <- scored$data; traits <- scored$outcomes
  path <- file.path(root, "OpenMx_lme4_constraints_20260911/baseline",
                    paste(dataset, spec, paste0(method,".rds"), sep="__"))
  baseline <- readRDS(path)$result
} else {
  mh7 <- c(NORMAL=1,STRESS=2,ANXIETY=3,DEPRESSION=4,BIPOLAR=5,PERSONALITY_DISORDER=6,SUICIDAL=7)
  mh3 <- c(NORMAL=1,STRESS=1,ANXIETY=2,DEPRESSION=2,BIPOLAR=3,PERSONALITY_DISORDER=3,SUICIDAL=3)
  score <- switch(dataset, mental_health_7L=unname(mh7[raw$label]),
                  mental_health_3L=unname(mh3[raw$label]), as.numeric(raw$severity))
  data <- data.frame(item=factor(raw$item_id),evaluator=factor(raw$evaluator),
                     prompt=factor(raw$prompt_type),temp=factor(raw$temperature),seed=factor(raw$seed),
                     score=score)
  traits <- "score"
  folder <- if (corpus=="mh") "mental_health" else dataset
  path <- file.path(root, "lme4/outputs/rmd_lme4_point_only_20260910",folder,"fit_checkpoints",
                    paste0(dataset,"_",method,"_",spec,".rds"))
  baseline <- readRDS(path)$fit
}
stopifnot(inherits(baseline,"lme4_point_fit"), identical(baseline$outcomes,traits),
          isTRUE(baseline$converged), baseline$reml==reml, baseline$spec==spec, !anyNA(data),
          !anyDuplicated(data[.point_facets]))
groups <- baseline$groups
aliases <- setNames(sprintf("source%02d",seq_along(groups)),groups)
for (g in groups) {
  parts <- strsplit(g,":",fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
  data[[aliases[[g]]]] <- do.call(interaction,c(data[parts],list(drop=TRUE,lex.order=TRUE)))
}
# With zero cross-trait covariance the native lme4 likelihood consists of
# independent trait blocks conditional on the same residual variance. This
# representation avoids constructing a large stacked random-effects matrix.
build_blocks <- function(data) {
  form <- reformulate(sprintf("(1 | %s)",aliases), response="y")
  lapply(traits,function(trait) {
    data$y <- data[[trait]]
    lf <- lme4::lFormula(form,data=data,REML=reml)
    mapping <- match(names(lf$reTrms$cnms),unname(aliases))
    stopifnot(setequal(mapping,seq_along(groups)))
    dev <- do.call(lme4::mkLmerDevfun,lf)
    env <- environment(dev)
    list(evaluate=function(theta) {
      invisible(dev(theta[mapping]))
      c(logdet=env$pp$ldL2()+if (reml) env$pp$ldRX2() else 0,
        rss=env$resp$wrss()+env$pp$sqrL(1))
    }, order=mapping)
  })
}
baseline_s2 <- baseline$components$Residual[1,1]
initial <- vapply(seq_along(traits),function(j)
  vapply(baseline$components[groups],function(m) m[j,j]/baseline_s2,numeric(1)),numeric(length(groups)))
df <- function(n) n-as.integer(reml)
objective_terms <- function(x,s2,n) x["logdet"]+x["rss"]/s2+df(n)*log(2*pi*s2)
check_baseline <- build_blocks(data)
initial_value <- sum(vapply(seq_along(traits), function(j)
  objective_terms(check_baseline[[j]]$evaluate(sqrt(initial[,j])),baseline_s2,nrow(data)), numeric(1)))
stopifnot(abs(initial_value-baseline$minus2loglik)<1e-4)
rm(check_baseline); invisible(gc())
data <- droplevels(data[!remove,])
stopifnot(all(vapply(data[.point_facets],nlevels,integer(1))==baseline$counts))
blocks <- build_blocks(data)
n <- nrow(data); D <- length(traits); K <- length(groups)
# Optimize in nonnegative relative variances. A one-sided derivative at zero
# checks whether a boundary component would improve after entering the model.
# Scale each parameter by its resolution and warm-start from the complete fit.
units <- vapply(groups,function(g) {
  f <- data[[aliases[[g]]]]
  nlevels(f)/n
},numeric(1))
scale <- pmax(initial,units)
evaluate <- function(par, gradient=FALSE) {
  z <- matrix(par[seq_len(K*D)],K,D); s2 <- exp(tail(par,1L))
  value <- 0; grad <- matrix(0,K,D); rss <- 0
  for (j in seq_len(D)) {
    block <- blocks[[j]]$evaluate
    terms_at <- function(y) block(sqrt(pmax(y,0)*scale[,j]))
    v <- terms_at(z[,j])
    value <- value+objective_terms(v,s2,n)
    rss <- rss+unname(v["rss"])
    if (gradient) for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      h <- 0.0001*max(1,z[k,j])
      upper <- lower <- z[,j]; upper[k] <- upper[k]+h
      lower[k] <- max(0,lower[k]-h)
      delta <- terms_at(upper)-if (lower[k]==z[k,j]) v else terms_at(lower)
      grad[k,j] <- (delta["logdet"]+delta["rss"]/s2)/(upper[k]-lower[k])
    }
  }
  if (gradient) c(as.vector(grad),D*df(n)-rss/s2) else unname(value)
}
start <- c(as.vector(initial/scale),log(baseline_s2))
lower <- c(rep(0,K*D),-Inf)
# nlminb can stop on a very flat objective. A second tighter pass is used if
# the scaled score still exceeds the specified tolerance.
opt <- nlminb(start,evaluate,gradient=function(x)evaluate(x,TRUE),lower=lower,
              control=list(rel.tol=1e-12,x.tol=1e-9,iter.max=800,eval.max=2000))
score_at <- function(par) {
  grad <- evaluate(par,TRUE)
  at_boundary <- par<=lower+1e-8
  grad[at_boundary] <- pmin(0,grad[at_boundary])
  max(abs(grad))
}
score <- score_at(opt$par)
if (opt$convergence!=0 || score>0.05) {
  opt <- nlminb(opt$par,evaluate,gradient=function(x)evaluate(x,TRUE),lower=lower,
                control=list(rel.tol=1e-14,x.tol=1e-11,iter.max=1200,eval.max=3000))
  score <- score_at(opt$par)
}
stopifnot(is.finite(opt$objective),score<0.15)
# Recheck the attained fitted residual scale against the analytic profile.
z <- matrix(head(opt$par,-1L),K,D)
ratios <- z*scale; s2 <- exp(tail(opt$par,1L))
driver <- sub("^--file=","",grep("^--file=",commandArgs(),value=TRUE)[1])
source(file.path(dirname(gsub("~+~"," ",driver,fixed=TRUE)),"template_exclusion_native.R"))
  gradient_native_optimizer <- function(dev, theta, map) {
    par0 <- c(as.vector(ratios/scale),log(s2))
    # Optimize the identical native lme4 likelihood in bounded variance
    # coordinates, then reconstruct its ordinary stacked lme4 representation.
    oo <- optim(par0,evaluate,gr=function(x)evaluate(x,TRUE),method="L-BFGS-B",
      lower=lower,control=list(factr=5000,pgtol=0.00025,maxit=250,lmm=12))
    score <- score_at(oo$par)
    cat("Independent block solve",oo$convergence,score,oo$value,"\n")
    stopifnot(oo$convergence==0L,score<0.05,oo$value<=evaluate(par0)+1e-6)
    th <- sqrt((matrix(head(oo$par,-1),K,D)*scale)[map])
    sv <- dev(th)
    stopifnot(abs(sv-oo$value)<1e-4)
    list(par=as.numeric(th),fval=sv,conv=oo$convergence,feval=unname(oo$counts[1]),
      message="L-BFGS-B on native lme4 trait blocks; verified against the stacked likelihood")
  }
use_block_optimizer <- method=="ML" && (
  (dataset=="mental_health_6flag" && spec %in% c("f3_additive","f3_complete")) ||
  (dataset=="drug_review_4aspect" && spec=="f3_complete"))
native <- refine_native(data,traits,groups,aliases,ratios,reml,
                        if (use_block_optimizer) gradient_native_optimizer else NULL)
stopifnot(abs(native$start_value-opt$objective)<1e-4)
ratios <- native$ratios; s2 <- native$s2
final_par <- c(as.vector(ratios/scale), log(s2))
score <- score_at(final_par)
stopifnot(abs(evaluate(final_par)-native$objective)<1e-4,score<0.15)
pooled <- sum(vapply(seq_len(D),function(j) blocks[[j]]$evaluate(sqrt(ratios[,j]))["rss"],numeric(1)))/(D*df(n))
stopifnot(abs(pooled/s2-1)<1e-5)
filtered <- baseline
filtered$components <- lapply(seq_len(K),function(k) diag(as.numeric(s2*ratios[k,]),D))
names(filtered$components) <- groups
filtered$components$Residual <- diag(as.numeric(s2),D)
evaluate_design <- function(fit,design) {
  r <- point_reliability(fit,design)
  if (!multi) return(r$per_trait)
  u <- diag(r$universe_covariance); e <- diag(r$relative_error_covariance)
  w <- u/pmax(e,pmax(1e-8,1e-6*u)); w <- w/sum(w)

    # Final stack with a native lme4 formula, freely optimized from the
# block-likelihood starting values. Scalar trait indicators reproduce the
# diagonal-source, common-residual specification of Supplementary Table S19.
refine_native <- function(data, traits, groups, aliases, ratios, reml, block_optimizer=NULL) {
  D <- length(traits); n <- nrow(data)
  names_trait <- sprintf("indicator%02d",seq_len(D))
  j_long <- rep(seq_len(D),each=n)
  long <- data.frame(y=as.vector(as.matrix(data[traits])))
  for (j in seq_len(D)) long[[names_trait[j]]] <- as.numeric(j_long==j)
  for (g in groups) long[[aliases[[g]]]] <- rep(data[[aliases[[g]]]],D)
  random <- unlist(lapply(groups,function(g)
    sprintf("(0 + %s | %s)",names_trait,aliases[[g]])))
  formula <- reformulate(c(names_trait,random),response="y",intercept=FALSE)
  ctrl <- lme4::lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",calc.derivs=FALSE)
  lf <- lme4::lFormula(formula,data=long,REML=reml,control=ctrl)
  # The zero-valued trait-indicator entries can be omitted from the sparse
  # design matrix without altering any element of the likelihood.
  lf$reTrms$Zt <- Matrix::drop0(lf$reTrms$Zt)
  cn <- lf$reTrms$cnms
  map <- cbind(match(names(cn),unname(aliases)),match(vapply(cn,`[[`,character(1),1L),names_trait))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(map),!anyDuplicated(as.data.frame(map)),nrow(map)==D*length(groups))
  theta <- sqrt(ratios[map])
  dev <- do.call(lme4::mkLmerDevfun,lf)
  start_value <- dev(theta)
  if (is.null(block_optimizer)) {
    opt <- lme4::optimizeLmer(dev,optimizer="bobyqa",start=list(theta=theta),
        control=list(maxfun=100000,rhobeg=1e-4,rhoend=1e-7),calc.derivs=FALSE)
  } else {
    opt <- block_optimizer(dev,theta,map)
  }
  invisible(dev(opt$par))
  model <- lme4::mkMerMod(environment(dev),opt,lf$reTrms,fr=lf$fr)
  stopifnot(as.integer(opt$conv)==0, max(abs(lme4::getME(model,"theta")-opt$par))<1e-12)
  native <- -2*as.numeric(logLik(model))
  stopifnot(native<=start_value+1e-6, abs(native-dev(opt$par))<1e-5)
  ratios[map] <- opt$par^2
  list(ratios=ratios,s2=as.numeric(sigma(model)^2),objective=native,
       status=as.integer(opt$conv),message=if (length(opt$message)) as.character(opt$message)[1] else "optimizer status zero",evals=opt$feval,
       singular=lme4::isSingular(model),start_value=start_value)
}

text_length_items.csv gives the corpus, item identifier, fixed batch and position, word count, number of evaluations, number assigned the default category, and complete-template matches for all 300 texts. text_length_corpora.csv, text_length_batches.csv and text_length_mh_quartiles.csv summarize these counts, and text_length_default_labels.csv compares default-category labels across corpora. The script reads the sampled-item files and checks each text against the stored text hash in every scoring record.

    View code
    """Audit words in the original 100 texts, five fixed batches and scoring records per task.
Run from the repository root: python3 /path/to/template_text_lengths.py OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
The companion default_audit.py must be in the same directory as this script.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys

import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from default_audit import default_item

WORDS = re.compile(r"[^\W_]+(?:['’\-][^\W_]+)*", re.UNICODE)
DATA = Path("data")


def read_csv(path):
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        return list(csv.DictReader(handle))


def summarize(dataset):
    sample = read_csv(DATA / f"{dataset}_sample_100.csv")
    positions = {r["item_id"]: i for i, r in enumerate(sample)}
    assert len(sample) == len(positions) == 100
    item_rows = []
    for i, row in enumerate(sample):
        text = row["text"]
        item_rows.append(dict(dataset=dataset, item_id=row["item_id"], batch=i // 20 + 1,
                              position=i % 20 + 1, words=len(WORDS.findall(text)),
                              drug_metadata_words=(sum(len(WORDS.findall(row[k] or "nan"))
                                                       for k in ("ingredient", "condition"))
                                                  if dataset == "drug" else 0),
                              evaluations=0, default_label=0, exact_matches=0))
    # The original Drug-Review notebook stringified a missing metadata field as nan.
    hashes = {r["item_id"]: hashlib.md5(r["text"].encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() for r in sample}
    default_label = "NEUTRAL" if dataset == "drug" else "NORMAL"
    conditions = set()
    for row in read_csv(DATA / f"{dataset}_labeling_final.csv"):
        idx = positions[row["item_id"]]
        result = item_rows[idx]
        obj = json.loads(row["raw_json"])
        assert row["text_hash"] == hashes[row["item_id"]]
        assert obj["index"] == result["position"] - 1
        setting = tuple(row[k] for k in ("item_id", "evaluator", "prompt_type", "temperature", "seed"))
        assert setting not in conditions
        conditions.add(setting)
        result["evaluations"] += 1
        is_default_label = row["label"] == default_label
        matches = obj == default_item(dataset, obj["index"])
        assert not matches or is_default_label
        result["default_label"] += is_default_label
        result["exact_matches"] += matches
    assert all(r["evaluations"] == 216 for r in item_rows)
    assert sum(r["exact_matches"] for r in item_rows) == {"hate":415,"mh":3374,"drug":258}[dataset]
    return item_rows


def write_csv(path, rows):
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as file:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(file, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def label_counts(rows):
    n = sum(r["evaluations"] for r in rows)
    labelled = sum(r["default_label"] for r in rows)
    matches = sum(r["exact_matches"] for r in rows)
    retained = n - matches
    return dict(texts=len(rows), evaluations=n, default_label=labelled, exact_matches=matches,
                default_label_rate=labelled/n if n else None, match_rate=matches/n if n else None,
                retained=retained, retained_default_label=labelled-matches,
                retained_default_label_rate=(labelled-matches)/retained if retained else None)


def main(out):
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
    items = []
    summaries = []
    batches = []
    quartiles = []
    label_groups = []
    for corpus in ("hate", "mh", "drug"):
        rows = summarize(corpus)
        items.extend(rows)
        words = np.array([r["words"] for r in rows])
        counts = [r["exact_matches"] for r in rows]
        default_counts = [r["default_label"] for r in rows]
        for band, block in (("all", rows), ("at_most_20", [r for r in rows if r["words"] <= 20]),
                            ("over_20", [r for r in rows if r["words"] > 20])):
            label_groups.append(dict(dataset=corpus, word_band=band, **label_counts(block)))
        q1, median, q3 = np.quantile(words, [0.25,0.50,0.75], method="linear")
        summaries.append(dict(dataset=corpus, texts=len(rows), mean=words.mean(),
                              minimum=words.min(), q1=q1, median=median, q3=q3, maximum=words.max(),
                              words_over_200=int((words>200).sum()), normal_or_neutral=sum(r["default_label"] for r in rows),
                              matches=sum(counts), evaluations=sum(r["evaluations"] for r in rows),
                              spearman_item_words_vs_match_rate=spearmanr(words, counts).statistic,
                              spearman_item_words_vs_default_label_rate=spearmanr(words, default_counts).statistic))
        for batch in range(1,6):
            subset = [r for r in rows if r["batch"] == batch]
            total = sum(r["evaluations"] for r in subset)
            matches = sum(r["exact_matches"] for r in subset)
            batches.append(dict(dataset=corpus, batch=batch, texts=len(subset),
                                words=sum(r["words"] for r in subset),
                                drug_metadata_words=sum(r["drug_metadata_words"] for r in subset),
                                matches=matches, evaluations=total, match_rate=matches/total))
        if corpus=="mh":
            source_labels = {r["item_id"]: r["original_label"] for r in read_csv(DATA/"mh_sample_100.csv")}
            assert set(source_labels) == {r["item_id"] for r in rows} and all(source_labels.values())
            ordered=sorted(rows,key=lambda r:r["words"])
            for j in range(4):
                block=ordered[j*25:(j+1)*25]
                if j: assert block[0]["words"]>ordered[j*25-1]["words"]
                stats = label_counts(block)
                source_normal = sum(source_labels[r["item_id"]] == "NORMAL" for r in block)
                quartiles.append(dict(quartile=j+1,texts=len(block),minimum=block[0]["words"],
                                      maximum=block[-1]["words"],evaluations=stats["evaluations"],
                                      normal=stats["default_label"],normal_rate=stats["default_label_rate"],
                                      matches=stats["exact_matches"],match_rate=stats["match_rate"],
                                      source_normal=source_normal,retained=stats["retained"],
                                      retained_normal=stats["retained_default_label"],
                                      retained_normal_rate=stats["retained_default_label_rate"]))
    for label, values in (("items",items),("corpora",summaries),("batches",batches),
                          ("mh_quartiles",quartiles),("default_labels",label_groups)):
        write_csv(out/f"text_length_{label}.csv",values)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(Path(sys.argv[1]))

    View code
    """Count complete-template matches and default-category judgements by source text.
From the repository root, run python3 /path/to/template_item_agreement.py OUTPUT.csv.
The existing text_length_items.csv and default_audit.py are read beside this script.
"""
import csv
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from default_audit import default_item

DATA = Path("data")
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def read_rows(path):
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        yield from csv.DictReader(f)


def score_dataset(dataset, item_audit):
    source = list(read_rows(DATA / f"{dataset}_sample_100.csv"))
    by_id = {row["item_id"]: row for row in source}
    assert len(source) == len(by_id) == 100
    label = "NEUTRAL" if dataset == "drug" else "NORMAL"
    counts = defaultdict(Counter)
    matched_settings = defaultdict(dict)
    for row in read_rows(DATA / f"{dataset}_labeling_final.csv"):
        item = row["item_id"]
        model = row["evaluator"]
        audit = item_audit[dataset, item]
        obj = json.loads(row["raw_json"])
        assert obj["index"] + 1 == int(audit["position"]) and row["label"] == obj["label"]
        setting = (row["prompt_type"], row["temperature"], row["seed"])
        joint = matched_settings[item, setting]
        assert model not in joint
        exact = obj == default_item(dataset, obj["index"])
        is_default = row["label"] == label
        assert not exact or is_default
        joint[model] = (exact, is_default)
        cell = counts[item, model]
        cell["evaluations"] += 1
        cell["exact"] += exact
        cell["default"] += is_default
    models = sorted({model for _, model in counts})
    settings = {setting for _, setting in matched_settings}
    assert len(settings) == 54 and len(models) == 4 and len(matched_settings) == 5400
    assert all(set(joint) == set(models) for joint in matched_settings.values())
    output = []
    for index, source_item in enumerate(source):
        item = source_item["item_id"]
        cells = [counts[item, model] for model in models]
        audit = item_audit[dataset, item]
        assert index == (int(audit["batch"]) - 1) * 20 + int(audit["position"]) - 1
        assert all(cell["evaluations"] == 54 for cell in cells)
        matches = sum(cell["exact"] for cell in cells)
        defaults = sum(cell["default"] for cell in cells)
        aligned = [matched_settings[item, setting] for setting in settings]
        assert matches == int(audit["exact_matches"]) and defaults == int(audit["default_label"])
        row = dict(dataset=dataset, item_id=item, batch=audit["batch"], position=audit["position"],
                   words=audit["words"], source_mental_health_label=source_item.get("original_label", ""),
                   default_category=label, evaluations=216, exact_matches=matches,
                   default_labels=defaults, retained=216-matches, retained_default_labels=defaults-matches,
                   models_any_match=sum(cell["exact"] > 0 for cell in cells),
                   models_majority_match=sum(2*cell["exact"] > 54 for cell in cells),
                   models_majority_default=sum(2*cell["default"] > 54 for cell in cells),
                   models_with_retained_evaluations=sum(cell["exact"] < 54 for cell in cells),
                   models_majority_default_after_exclusion=sum(
                       2*(cell["default"]-cell["exact"]) > 54-cell["exact"] for cell in cells),
                   settings_all_four_exact=sum(all(exact for exact, _ in joint.values()) for joint in aligned),
                   settings_all_four_default=sum(all(labelled for _, labelled in joint.values()) for joint in aligned))
        for model, cell in zip(models, cells):
            row[model + "_exact_matches"] = cell["exact"]
            row[model + "_default_labels"] = cell["default"]
        output.append(row)
    return output


def main(path):
    audit = {(r["dataset"], r["item_id"]): r for r in read_rows(HERE / "text_length_items.csv")}
    assert len(audit) == 300
    rows = []
    for dataset in ("hate", "mh", "drug"):
        rows.extend(score_dataset(dataset, audit))
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=rows[0])
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(Path(sys.argv[1]))

    "template_item_agreement.csv", "text_length_corpora.csv", "text_length_batches.csv",
    "text_length_mh_quartiles.csv", "text_length_default_labels.csv", "text_length_items.csv",
    "template_exclusion_coefficients.csv", "template_exclusion_components.csv",
    "template_exclusion_candidate_BIC.csv", "template_exclusion_diagnostics.csv",
    "prompt_exclusion_points.csv", "prompt_exclusion_contrasts.csv", "prompt_exclusion_draws.csv",
    "univariate_sem.csv", "univariate_sem.py", "prompt_exclusion.R", "prompt_reml_objective.cpp",
    "default_audit.py", "prompt_check.R", "prompt_check.txt",
    "evaluator_exclusion_points.csv", "evaluator_exclusion_contrasts.csv", "evaluator_exclusion_draws.csv",
    "evaluator_exclusion.R", "evaluator_check.R", "evaluator_check.txt",
    "trait_level_check.csv", "trait_level_exclusion.csv", "trait_level_check.R", "trait_level_exclusion.R",
    "prompt_revision_check.csv", "prompt_revision_check.R",
    "holdout_check.csv", "holdout_check.R",
    "tail_run_check.csv", "tail_run_check.txt", "tail_run_check.py",
)
INDEX = """Supplementary annotation analyses for Tables S25-S27 and S31-S38

Codes: hate = Hate-Speech, mh = Mental-Health, drug = Drug-Review.
Each corpus contains 100 texts, each evaluated under 216 conditions.
A complete match means equality with the entire stored default object.
It provides an upper bound on use of the whole-item fallback.

template_matches_by_condition.csv: All 216 evaluator, prompt, temperature and seed combinations per corpus. Each row gives the count and percentage of 100 evaluations that matched. The default_category_count column includes all ratings assigned NORMAL (Hate-Speech and Mental-Health) or NEUTRAL (Drug-Review).
template_item_agreement.csv: One row per text. Each of four models supplied 54 evaluations. Models are counted as having a majority when more than half their evaluations assigned the category. After exclusion, the denominator uses that model's remaining evaluations of that text. The settings_all_four columns require the same prompt, temperature and seed across the four evaluators.
text_length_corpora.csv, text_length_batches.csv and text_length_items.csv: Word counts, entire-template matches and category frequencies at the corpus, batch and text levels.
text_length_default_labels.csv: Default-category rates in each corpus overall and in the common length bands of up to 20 words and over 20 words. Rates for an empty group are blank.
text_length_mh_quartiles.csv: Groups of 25 Mental-Health texts ordered by length. Source labels refer to texts. Other label and match rates refer to evaluations.
template_exclusion_coefficients.csv: Paired relative reliability (E-rho-squared) and absolute dependability (Phi) using lme4. Delta is the estimate after exclusion minus the complete-data estimate. Single and full_panel refer to projections for one and 216 evaluations. Rows marked REML are the selected specification reported in Tables S31-S32.
template_exclusion_components.csv: Corresponding paired variances by source and outcome, in squared score units.
template_exclusion_candidate_BIC.csv: BIC for the eleven ML candidates per outcome set, compared within each dataset and panel. The delta columns are relative to the minimum across all candidates within that panel. To compare a family with the selected Family 2 fit, subtract the BIC for f2_complete_drift from the lowest BIC in that family, using the same panel.
template_exclusion_diagnostics.csv: Estimation and coverage checks for 77 candidate ML fits and seven selected REML fits. Tables S31-S33 use point estimates without bootstrap resampling.
univariate_sem.csv: Unrounded coefficients and their relative and absolute standard errors of measurement in score points for the 12 score/design combinations in Table S26.
prompt_exclusion_points.csv: Within-prompt REML item-by-evaluator variance by analysis panel and outcome (mh7 and mh3 are the two Mental-Health codings).
prompt_exclusion_contrasts.csv: Rubric or chain-of-thought minus minimal, before and after removing complete matches. Change is after minus before. Bounds here are pointwise paired 95% percentile intervals for mh7 only. prompt_check.txt gives the original full-panel intervals for all four outcomes.
prompt_exclusion_draws.csv: Within-prompt item-by-evaluator variances from the same 1,000 text samples across both panels and all three prompts for mh7. Columns beginning with excluded use the retained observations after removing whole-template matches.
evaluator_exclusion_points.csv, evaluator_exclusion_contrasts.csv and evaluator_exclusion_draws.csv: The same three files for item-by-prompt variance within each evaluator. Contrasts are each evaluator minus gpt-4o-mini. evaluator_check.txt gives the full-panel mean-square estimates and intervals for all four outcomes.
trait_level_check.csv and trait_level_exclusion.csv: The prompt and evaluator analyses repeated for each flag, grouped indicator and aspect (Table S36). The first file gives full-panel mean-square estimates, differences from the reference level (minimal, gpt-4o-mini) and paired percentile intervals. The second gives REML estimates before and after removing complete matches.
prompt_revision_check.csv: Chain-of-thought minus rubric item-by-evaluator variance for the four holistic scores and every trait, on the full panel (with paired percentile intervals) and after removing complete matches. The chain-of-thought prompt extends the rubric with a reasoning checklist and anti-default-bias instructions, so the contrast compares two complete prompts.
holdout_check.csv: Expected and observed correlations between each held-out evaluator or prompt and the remaining panel (Table S37), with the paired percentile interval of their difference.
tail_run_check.csv and tail_run_check.txt: Requests whose last two or more texts all matched the template (Table S38). The CSV has one row per such request, with the first matched position, the number of evaluations in the run, and how many of those texts matched in fewer than 10% of their other 71 evaluations under the same prompt. The text file summarizes the runs by evaluator, prompt and temperature.

To reproduce S26-S27 and S36-S38, extract the scripts to one directory. From the repository root, run the following with paths to that directory, the mask directory and the output directory:
  python3 /path/to/univariate_sem.py /path/to/output/univariate_sem.csv
  Rscript --vanilla /path/to/prompt_check.R
  python3 /path/to/default_audit.py --mask-dir /path/to/masks
  Rscript --vanilla /path/to/prompt_exclusion.R /path/to/masks /path/to/output
  Rscript --vanilla /path/to/evaluator_check.R
  Rscript --vanilla /path/to/evaluator_exclusion.R /path/to/masks /path/to/output
  Rscript --vanilla /path/to/trait_level_check.R /path/to/output/trait_level_check.csv
  Rscript --vanilla /path/to/trait_level_exclusion.R /path/to/masks /path/to/output/trait_level_exclusion.csv
  Rscript --vanilla /path/to/prompt_revision_check.R /path/to/output/prompt_revision_check.csv /path/to/saved/outputs
  Rscript --vanilla /path/to/holdout_check.R /path/to/output/holdout_check.csv
  python3 /path/to/tail_run_check.py /path/to/output/tail_run_check.csv > /path/to/output/tail_run_check.txt
The prompt refit uses lme4, nloptr and Rcpp with a C++ compiler. Keep prompt_reml_objective.cpp beside prompt_exclusion.R. The bootstrap likelihood is checked against direct lme4 fits on each original mh7 panel and its first resample. The evaluator refit uses lme4 only and accepts an optional number of cores as a third argument. tail_run_check.py reads default_audit.py and text_length_items.csv from its own directory.
"""


def condition_counts():
    rows = []
    for dataset, expected in (("hate", 415), ("mh", 3374), ("drug", 258)):
        counts = Counter()
        defaults = Counter()
        matches = Counter()
        seen = set()
        default_category = "NEUTRAL" if dataset == "drug" else "NORMAL"
        with (DATA / f"{dataset}_labeling_final.csv").open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
            for row in csv.DictReader(handle):
                key = (row["evaluator"], row["prompt_type"], row["temperature"], row["seed"])
                observation = (row["item_id"], key)
                assert observation not in seen
                seen.add(observation)
                obj = json.loads(row["raw_json"])
                counts[key] += 1
                defaults[key] += row["label"] == default_category
                matches[key] += obj == default_item(dataset, obj["index"])
        assert len(counts) == 216 and set(counts.values()) == {100} and sum(matches.values()) == expected
        for key in sorted(counts):
            rows.append((dataset, *key, counts[key], defaults[key], matches[key], 100*matches[key]/counts[key]))
    return rows


def build(output):
    stream = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.writer(stream)
    writer.writerow(("dataset", "evaluator", "prompt", "temperature", "seed", "evaluations",
                     "default_category_count", "exact_template_matches", "match_rate_pct"))
    writer.writerows(condition_counts())
    with ZipFile(output, "w", compression=ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        archive.writestr("README.txt", INDEX)
        archive.writestr("template_matches_by_condition.csv", stream.getvalue())
        for name in FILES:
            archive.write(HERE / name, arcname=name)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build(Path(sys.argv[1]))

    # Trait-level counterpart of prompt_check.R and evaluator_check.R for the three multivariate outcome sets.
# Run from the repository root with the path of the output CSV as the argument.
# For each flag, grouped indicator and aspect: item-by-evaluator variance within each prompt and
# item-by-prompt variance within each evaluator, from mean squares on the balanced panel, with paired
# percentile intervals for each level minus the reference level (minimal; gpt-4o-mini).
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args)==1L)
base <- 'data'
# A paired resample preserves the complete panel for every sampled item.
set.seed(429)
weights <- replicate(1000, tabulate(sample.int(100, 100, replace=TRUE), nbins=100))
w <- cbind(rep(1,100),weights)
weightedSS <- function(x){
  x <- matrix(x, nrow=100)
  drop(crossprod(w,rowSums(x^2))) - rowSums(crossprod(w,x)^2)/100
}
prompts <- c("minimal","rubric","cot")
evaluators <- c("gpt-4o-mini","gemini-2.5-flash","llama-70b","mistral-small")
# z holds one level of the fixed facet; `across` names the facet whose item interaction is estimated.
check_one <- function(z, across) {
  m <- tapply(z$score,list(z$item_id,z[[across]],z$temperature),mean)
  levels_across <- dim(m)[2]
  stopifnot(dim(m)[1]==100L,dim(m)[3]==6L,all(is.finite(m)),all(table(z$item_id,z[[across]],z$temperature)==3))
  ma <- apply(m,1:2,mean)
  ms_interaction <- 18*weightedSS(ma-rowMeans(ma))/(99*(levels_across-1))
  ms_temperature_within <- 3*weightedSS(sweep(m,1:2,ma,"-"))/(99*levels_across*5)
  (ms_interaction-ms_temperature_within)/18
}
mh <- read.csv(file.path(base,'mh_labeling_final.csv'), colClasses='character')
drug <- read.csv(file.path(base,'drug_labeling_final.csv'), colClasses='character')
flag <- function(name) as.numeric(mh[[paste0(name,'_present')]]=="True")
aspect <- function(name) unname(c(NEGATIVE=1,NEUTRAL=2,POSITIVE=3)[drug[[paste0('ai_',name)]]])
traits <- list(
  mental_health_6flag=list(depression=flag("depression"),anxiety=flag("anxiety"),suicidal=flag("suicidal"),
                           stress=flag("stress"),bipolar=flag("bipolar"),personality_disorder=flag("personality_disorder")),
  mental_health_3group=list(stress=flag("stress"),anxiety_depression=pmax(flag("anxiety"),flag("depression")),
                            bipolar_personality_suicidal=pmax(flag("bipolar"),flag("personality_disorder"),flag("suicidal"))),
  drug_review_4aspect=list(efficacy=aspect("efficacy"),safety=aspect("safety"),burden=aspect("burden"),cost=aspect("cost")))
rows <- list()
for (set in names(traits)) for (trait in names(traits[[set]])) {
  d <- if (set=="drug_review_4aspect") drug else mh
  d$score <- traits[[set]][[trait]]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$score),nrow(d)==21600L)
  for (within in c("prompt","evaluator")) {
    levels_fixed <- if (within=="prompt") prompts else evaluators
    est <- sapply(levels_fixed,function(level) if (within=="prompt")
      check_one(d[d$prompt_type==level,],"evaluator") else check_one(d[d$evaluator==level,],"prompt_type"))
    for (k in seq_along(levels_fixed)) {
      difference <- est[,k]-est[,1]
      interval <- if (k==1) c(NA,NA) else quantile(difference[-1],c(.025,.975),names=FALSE)
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.frame(outcome_set=set,trait=trait,within=within,level=levels_fixed[k],
        variance=est[1,k],difference_from_reference=if (k==1) NA else difference[1],lower=interval[1],upper=interval[2])
    }
  }
}
write.csv(do.call(rbind,rows),args[1],row.names=FALSE)

    # Trait-level counterpart of prompt_exclusion.R and evaluator_exclusion.R (point estimates only).
# Run from the repository root with a mask directory and the path of the output CSV as arguments.
# REML within each prompt (text, text by evaluator, text by evaluator by temperature) and within each
# evaluator (text, text by prompt, text by prompt by temperature), before and after removing every
# record identical to the task template.
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args)==2L)
mask_dir <- args[1]
library(lme4)
input <- "data"
prompts <- c("minimal","rubric","cot")
evaluators <- c("gpt-4o-mini","gemini-2.5-flash","llama-70b","mistral-small")
native <- function(data) {
  model <- lmer(y ~ 0 + cell + (1|i) + (1|i:a) + (1|i:a:t), data=data, REML=TRUE,
                control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",calc.derivs=FALSE))
  stopifnot(model@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  unname(setNames(vc$vcov,vc$grp)["i:a"])
}
read_panel <- function(ds, expected) {
  raw <- read.csv(file.path(input,paste0(ds,"_labeling_final.csv")),colClasses="character")
  matches <- scan(file.path(mask_dir,paste0(ds,"_mask.txt")),quiet=TRUE)==1
  stopifnot(nrow(raw)==21600L,length(matches)==nrow(raw),sum(matches)==expected)
  list(raw=raw,matches=matches)
}
mh <- read_panel("mh",3374L)
drug <- read_panel("drug",258L)
flag <- function(name) as.numeric(mh$raw[[paste0(name,'_present')]]=="True")
aspect <- function(name) unname(c(NEGATIVE=1,NEUTRAL=2,POSITIVE=3)[drug$raw[[paste0('ai_',name)]]])
traits <- list(
  mental_health_6flag=list(depression=flag("depression"),anxiety=flag("anxiety"),suicidal=flag("suicidal"),
                           stress=flag("stress"),bipolar=flag("bipolar"),personality_disorder=flag("personality_disorder")),
  mental_health_3group=list(stress=flag("stress"),anxiety_depression=pmax(flag("anxiety"),flag("depression")),
                            bipolar_personality_suicidal=pmax(flag("bipolar"),flag("personality_disorder"),flag("suicidal"))),
  drug_review_4aspect=list(efficacy=aspect("efficacy"),safety=aspect("safety"),burden=aspect("burden"),cost=aspect("cost")))
rows <- list()
for (set in names(traits)) for (trait in names(traits[[set]])) {
  source <- if (set=="drug_review_4aspect") drug else mh
  raw <- source$raw
  y <- traits[[set]][[trait]]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(y))
  for (within in c("prompt","evaluator")) for (level in if (within=="prompt") prompts else evaluators)
    for (sample in c("full","excluded")) {
      keep <- (if (within=="prompt") raw$prompt_type==level else raw$evaluator==level) & (sample=="full" | !source$matches)
      data <- data.frame(y=y[keep],i=factor(raw$item_id[keep]),t=factor(raw$temperature[keep]),
                         a=factor(if (within=="prompt") raw$evaluator[keep] else raw$prompt_type[keep]))
      data$cell <- interaction(data$t,data$a,drop=TRUE)
      stopifnot(length(unique(data$i))==100)
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.frame(outcome_set=set,trait=trait,within=within,level=level,sample=sample,
        evaluations=nrow(data),variance=native(data))
    }
}
write.csv(do.call(rbind,rows),args[2],row.names=FALSE)

Table S37: hold-out check of evaluator and prompt interchangeability

Each evaluator, and then each prompt, is held out in turn. The item-related components of the selected specification are estimated by mean squares from the remaining levels only and give the correlation expected between the text means of the held-out level and those of the remaining panel if the held-out level were interchangeable with the fitted ones. holdout_check.csv gives the expected and observed correlations, their difference and its paired percentile interval from the same 1,000 text resamples (seed 429), for the four holistic scores, the three equal-weight composites and every flag, grouped indicator and aspect.

Rscript --vanilla calc/holdout_check.R work/holdout_check.csv
